policy: All source custom types are already resolved to canonical Mercury types. These moves remain deferred only because their battle mechanics still need a separate decision/implementation.

deferred.name: Heart Beat
deferred.reason: 2-5 hits plus user Speed +1 and Sp. Def -1 after the sequence

deferred.name: Audio Break
deferred.reason: damaging screen break plus disables the target's sound moves

deferred.name: Unleashed Power
deferred.reason: dynamic Hidden Power typing, dynamic Physical/Special category, screen removal, and source zero-PP/Z-move behavior

deferred.name: Blinding Speed
deferred.reason: dynamic user typing/category plus ally After You-style turn manipulation

deferred.name: Titan's Wrath
deferred.reason: damage uses user's highest non-HP stat and move type changes to user's type

deferred.name: Queso Blast
deferred.reason: 3-5-hit pattern is not a native Platinum multi-hit distribution

deferred.name: Hard Drive Crash
deferred.reason: damaging attack that removes 3 PP from the target's last move

deferred.name: Virus Inject
deferred.reason: custom debuff that increases all damage taken by 25%

deferred.name: Chthonic Malady
deferred.reason: combined -2 Attack/-2 Sp. Atk, Torment timer, Petrification, and protection bypass

deferred.name: Expunge
deferred.reason: Nuclear-target bonus is removed, but Fallout-specific accuracy behavior still needs a decision

deferred.name: Fallout
deferred.reason: custom five-turn Fallout field/weather effect must be redesigned now that Nuclear typing is removed

deferred.name: Quantum Leap
deferred.reason: two-turn vanish/invulnerability behavior needs an exact Platinum-state mapping

deferred.name: Nuclear Wind
deferred.reason: chance to create Fallout remains a custom field mechanic with conflicting source percentages
